dj.line:
Well, look at that — a pool that opens its doors and takes nothing off the top. Fee zero, which is either charity or confidence, and at this table they're the same thing.

Fresh felt, fresh chalk, hook sitting quiet in the corner like it's waiting to be dealt in. Pull up a chair; the house can afford to be patient.
